d:
'socha na tha' is Zaeden's fourth single from his upcoming album - Genesis 1:1
Zaeden's Note:
Imagine being enamored by your significant other, this song is an ode to that simple feeling. ‘socha na tha’ celebrates the little things and the feeling of being smitten right off the bat.
Audio Credits:
Written & Performed: Zaeden
Lyrics: Kunaal Verma & Zaeden
Production: Polar Beats
Mix & Master: Tom Norris
